_comment: WebNest protocol 1. Import into Pelican and replace the image name with your own built/pushed image. No image is published by this project.
name: WebNest · nginx + PHP 8.4
author: webnest@example.org
description: WebNest plugin runtime: PHP 8.4-FPM, nginx, Python supervisor. Requires building runtime/Dockerfile and changing the Docker image field. Not a drop-in egg for an arbitrary PHP image.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh set -eu mkdir -p /mnt/server/sites/default/public /mnt/server/webnest printf '%s\n' 'WebNest

A WebNest környezet elkészült.

Hozz létre egy webhelyet a Pelican Webhelykezelő menüjében.

' > /mnt/server/sites/default/public/index.html
